title: Angleton and others on George C. Marshall's team

tellings.quote: find is a lot of this cast of characters, including James Jesus Angleton, who went on to become the key person at the CIA, they all seem to have been part of General George C. Marshall's team

plain: Many of the people later tied to the UFO secret, including James Jesus Angleton, who became a key figure at the CIA, are said to have served together on General George C. Marshall's team around the end of the Second World War. The researcher Pippa Malmgren tells Michels this as her own finding, without naming a source, saying they "all seem to have been part of General George C. Marshall's team," and she also brings up John F. Kennedy and the defense secretary James Forrestal. If true, it would suggest a single circle of men handled the subject from the start.
